difficultySettings: none — the game has no difficulty setting
cheats: cheats disable trophies and saving; play the whole run cheat-free

missable.where: Chapter 1, balcony at Jason's house, the morning after 'Down to Earth'
missable.what: Meditate with Lucia, follow her, and choose Accept.
missable.warning: This is the only trophy in the game that can lock. Every other trophy stays earnable in free-roam after the story.
missable.dispute: Whether the meditation is actually required is unconfirmed: it raises the meditation counter, but it is not a marked meditation spot, and only 15 of the 18 meditations are needed for 100%. Do it anyway — it costs a minute and protects the run.
missable.saveRule: Save in a new slot right after the meditation, before continuing Chapter 1.

saveDiscipline.rule: Save at the start and at the end of each of the five chapters, and before the final mission.
saveDiscipline.cheats: Cheats disable trophies and saving — a cheat entered anywhere in the run poisons that save.
saveDiscipline.why: There is no mission replay and no New Game+, so a manual save is the only way back to an earlier chapter.

stages.title: Stage 1 — Play the story, clean and unhurried
stages.goal: Finish the story in one cheat-free run while protecting the single trophy that can lock.
stages.pointOfNoReturn: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation. It only appears the morning after 'Down to Earth'. If you push past that morning without meditating, the moment is gone for this run.
stages.beforeIt: Finish 'Down to Earth', sleep until morning, then go straight to the balcony before starting any other mission.

checklist.label: Manual saves made (start + end of each chapter)

steps: Start a fresh run and never enter a cheat code — cheats switch trophies off for the save.
Play the story in chapter order; there is no mission replay, so a missed story beat cannot be redone from a menu.
At the start of Chapter 1, open a fresh manual save slot and keep rotating saves as you go.
In Chapter 1, the morning after the mission 'Down to Earth', walk out to the balcony at Jason's house and meditate with Lucia.
When the choice appears during that meditation, follow Lucia and choose Accept.
Save in a new slot right after the meditation, before you keep playing Chapter 1.
Keep saving at the start and at the end of every chapter — five chapters, two saves each, inside your 15 manual slots.
Do not worry about collectibles yet; almost everything stays available in free-roam after the story.
Save in a fresh slot before the final mission, so you can return to the open world exactly as you left it.

stages.title: Stage 2 — The 100% checklist, after the story
stages.goal: Clear the open-world checklist the platinum's 100% requirement is built on.
stages.pointOfNoReturn: None in this stage. Free-roam stays open after the story, and every task here can be attempted again.
stages.beforeIt: Nothing to protect — but keep one manual save from the end of the story untouched, in case you ever need a clean post-story state.
steps: Work the 100% checklist in any order — nothing here locks, so pick the nearest task on the map first.
Finish challenges until you hold 70 of the 80 available; you do not need all 80.
Photograph and log vehicles until you reach 200 of the 277 in the world.
Track animals until you reach 100 of the 255 species and encounters.
Meditate at all 10 meditation locations until the counter reads 18 of 18.
Earn gold at the shooting ranges until you hold 42 golds across the 12 ranges.
Win drone races at all 14 drone-race locations.
Land stunts until the counter reads 250 of the 397 stunts in the world.
Clear gang operations — 39 of them feed the 100% total.

stages.title: Stage 3 — Collectibles, vaults and the long counts
stages.goal: Sweep the collectible sets and the big counters that take the most travelling.
stages.pointOfNoReturn: None in this stage. Collectibles stay in the world after the story and can be picked up in any order.
stages.beforeIt: No save discipline needed here beyond your normal rotating saves.
steps: Collect card sets until you hold 15 sets — that is the count the 100% checklist asks for.
Find WAiNK collectibles until the counter reads 100.
Dive the underwater discoveries until you hold 33 of them.
Find flamingos until the counter reads 100.
Rob bank vaults until you have opened 5 of the 8 vaults.
Pair the travelling with Stage 2 leftovers: a vehicle or animal on the way is still progress.
Use the in-game map markers and your own checklist — the counters in the tracker pane show your running totals.
Leave the rarest single items for last, when the map is nearly empty and each remaining marker stands out.

stages.title: Stage 4 — Final grind and the platinum
stages.goal: Close out the last counters, verify the checklist, and let the platinum pop.
stages.pointOfNoReturn: None — by this stage every remaining trophy is earned in free-roam, and nothing can lock.
stages.beforeIt: Keep that fresh save from the step above, so the moment before the platinum is preserved.
steps: Open the tracker and read every counter that is not yet at its target — those are the only jobs left.
Top up the smallest gaps first: a handful of stunts or a few more challenges is a quick win.
Re-check the 100% requirements one by one: 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals.
Confirm the meditations sit at 18 of 18, the range golds at 42, the drone races at 14 and the vaults at 5 of 8.
Confirm the collectibles: 15 card sets, 100 WAiNK, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 flamingos.
Make a final manual save in a fresh slot before the last trophy you expect to earn.
Earn the last remaining trophy and watch the platinum — 'Vice Got a Price!' — unlock with it.
